text:
QUOTE: "If it is present but rejected, `derive_scope` logs a WARNING and falls through to the whole-repo tier, with the rejection reason carried into that tier's reason string."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer only says the rejection reason is carried into the whole-repo tier's reason string. It never says the fallback always carries a reason saying which scope was used and why. The one mention of a reason in the no-declaration case is the test checking that the reason names `index_scope` and `.clew.yaml`, which doesn't state the mechanism the item requires.
